senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) whisper.—בל׳ in a low voice.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:1">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>היה שונה בל׳</he> was in the habit of studying in a low voice; (ib. 53ᵇ bot. <he>גריס בלחישה</he>).

<cite ref="Chagigah 14a:12">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="L00371"><he>לחש</he></cite>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:3">Is. III, 3</cite>) <he>זה שמוסרין לו סתרי תורה שניתנין בל׳</he> (v. Ms. M. in Rabb. D. S. a. l. a. Rashi to Is. l. c.) that is he to whom are handed over the secrets of the Law which are communicated in a low voice (cmp.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">Gen. R. s. 3</cite>, beg.); a. e.
